name: XDKNet 3.0.1.3
body:
XDKNet 3.0.1.3 fixes invite links that open on your server. In 3.0.1.2 the
sign-up page at /XDKNet/Join showed "Error processing request." instead of
the form. Update the server plugin to 3.0.1.3; nothing else changes, and
invites made before still work.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the Android TV APK below.
